# Saniya Farooqui — Full-Stack Web Developer

> Freelance Full-Stack Web Developer based in Vasai-Virar, Nallasopara & Mumbai, India. Co-Founder of KisanX (Avishkar 2024-25 Research Convention awardee). Works with React, Node.js, PHP, MySQL, MongoDB and React Native, and builds responsive websites, web apps and mobile apps for local businesses and clients worldwide.

Saniya Farooqui is a Full-Stack Web Developer and B.Sc. IT student at Mumbai University (Patkar-Varde College). She takes freelance web development projects, custom full-stack builds and responsive website design for businesses in Vasai-Virar, Nallasopara, Palghar and the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, and for remote clients worldwide. She is also open to internships and entry-level roles.
